{
  "title": "HUD Supervisor Requesting Subordinate's Personal Services",
  "setting": "Department of Housing and Urban Development, United States, present",
  "decider": "HUD supervisory employee",
  "agent_recast": false,
  "recast_note": "",
  "agent": "HUD supervisory employee",
  "agent_role": "decide",
  "situation": "A supervisory employee at the Department of Housing and Urban Development is contemplating asking an assistant to perform personal errands. The request would involve using the assistant's official duty time and also asking for additional personal services outside of duty hours. The supervisor knows that agency regulations restrict the use of official time for non‑official activities. The supervisor also understands that coercing a subordinate for personal work outside duty hours may be prohibited unless the arrangement is voluntary and properly compensated. The supervisor must decide what, if any, personal requests can be made to the subordinate.",
  "question": "What should the HUD supervisory employee do regarding asking the subordinate to perform personal errands during duty hours and personal services outside duty hours?",
  "facts": [
    {
      "id": "F1",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The Department of Housing and Urban Development employs supervisory employees.",
      "spans": ["src:e6c0a7bfba6c#p1.50"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "HUD supervisory employees may not ask a subordinate to run personal errands during duty hours.",
      "spans": ["src:e6c0a7bfba6c#p1.50"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "Directing or coercing a subordinate to perform personal activities during nonduty hours is an improper use of public office for private gain, violating § 2635.702(a).",
      "spans": ["src:e6c0a7bfba6c#p1.50"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F4",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "A voluntary arrangement with appropriate compensation permits a subordinate to provide services to the superior during nonduty hours.",
      "spans": ["src:e6c0a7bfba6c#p1.50"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F5",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "Inadequate compensation for such services would constitute a prohibited gift to the superior under subpart C.",
      "spans": ["src:e6c0a7bfba6c#p1.50"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F6",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "assessed",
      "fact": "The supervisor is considering requesting the subordinate to run personal errands during duty hours and to perform additional personal services outside duty hours.",
      "spans": []
    }
  ],
  "options": {
    "O1": {
      "do": "The supervisor may not ask the subordinate to run personal errands during duty hours.",
      "move": "act",
      "disposition": "prohibit",
      "irreversible": true
    },
    "O2": {
      "do": "The supervisor may ask the subordinate to run personal errands during duty hours.",
      "move": "act",
      "disposition": "allow",
      "irreversible": false
    },
    "O3": {
      "do": "The supervisor may ask the subordinate to provide voluntary services outside duty hours for appropriate compensation.",
      "move": "partial",
      "disposition": "permit",
      "irreversible": false
    }
  },
  "opposite_pair": ["O1", "O2"],
  "real_option": "O1",
  "authored_options": ["O2", "O3"]
}
